## Change

Describe one scoped change. Link each requirement, issue, or decision that controls the change.

## Evidence

List each command and its result. Include a sanitized artifact when the result needs objective evidence.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change has complete type annotations.
- [ ] The change has nominal and applicable failure tests.
- [ ] The locked quality commands pass.
- [ ] Public behavior and documentation agree.
- [ ] The change does not contain a secret, hostname, or private user path.
- [ ] The change states compatibility, migration, security, and schema effects.
- [ ] The change does not add unrelated work.

## Risks

List each known risk and follow-up dependency. Write `None` when there is no known risk.
